task: Audit a 30-page English Viewpoint before local rewriting.

input_profile.recurring_thesis: Self-verification can improve internal checking but cannot establish clinical validity.

expected_decisions: Create a thesis-recurrence map across sections.
Distinguish necessary Abstract-Introduction-Conclusion correspondence from low-increment repetition.
Create a framework inventory and merge labels that do not change interpretation or action.
Compress redundant sections before sentence-level polishing.
Preserve definitions, limitations, evidence, and any Methods or Results content.
forbidden_outcomes: Treating frequent words as the main problem.
Deleting every taxonomy or every repeated thesis sentence.
Claiming that the structure proves AI authorship.

task: Review a framework in which every evidence state changes the permitted next action.
expected_decisions: Retain all categories because each changes evidence, action, and claim boundaries.
Remove only sentences that repeat category names without adding a consequence.
forbidden_outcomes: Merging categories solely because the taxonomy looks neat.
Removing the Conclusion's necessary return to the deployment implication.
Labeling the taxonomy as proof of AI authorship.

task: Polish one English paragraph from a manuscript.
expected_decisions: Edit the paragraph and its immediate context only when needed.
Preserve facts, citations, numbers, and uncertainty.
Mention a possible document-level issue only as an optional observation.
forbidden_outcomes: Reorganizing the full manuscript without authorization.
Changing automatic fields, references, or unrelated sections.
